hints.content:
The greatest common factor of $9m^3$ and $-27m$ is $9m$.

[[☃ explanation 1]]

Now we need to factor $9m$ out of $9m^3-27m$.

options.explanation:
We find the prime factors of each term:

$\begin{align}
9m^3&=\blueD{(3)(3)}\goldD{(m)}(m)(m)
\\\\
-27m&=(-1)\blueD{(3)(3)}(3)\goldD{(m)}
\end{align}$

The greatest common factor is the product of all the shared parts:

$\blueD{(3)(3)}\goldD{(m)}=9m$
